Mr. Marvin Siflinger Acting Area Office Director Department of Housing and Urban Development 15 New Chardon Street Boston, MA 02114
RE: Draft Environmental Impact Statement Kendall Square Urban Renewal Project Cambridge, MA HUD Project No. R-108
Dear Mr. Siflinger:
Pursuant to the National Environmental Policy Act, the Boston Redevelopment Authority has reviewed the Draft Environmental Impact Statement for the Kendall Square Urban Renewal Project in Cambridge, in particular, as the project may relate to the City of Boston's transportation network. In general, our review of the transportation section of the Impact Statement indicates that the proposed Kendall Square development should not have significant adverse impact on City of Boston streets. However, there is one point that we feel should be addressed in more detail.
The Draft EIS states that, with regard to regional impacts, the preferred development plan for Kendall Square may generate as many as 18,500 daily trips within nine assigned corridors, but it does not provide more specific information as to the impact of these volumes on major abutting regional systems, including City of Boston systems. In fact, the report states "No adjustment was made for traffic that might return to preferred Boston routes such as Storrow Drive, and no adjustment was made for Tech Square trips that might already be 'counted' within corridor volumes". It is our feeling that a more detailed analysis of the regional impact of these traffic volume increases should be performed and presented in the Final EIS.
